heading: 1. What we collect
paragraphs: PLACEHOLDER COPY — not legal text. Replace before this demo goes near a real homeowner.

When you complete a visual assessment we collect the photographs you capture, the time and date each one was taken, and the assessment reference contained in the link you were sent. We do not collect your device location, your contacts, or any other photographs stored on your device.

heading: 2. Why we collect it
paragraphs: Your photographs are used to identify preventative maintenance work that reduces the risk of water damage and fire loss at the property. Findings are shared with your insurer so that eligible preventative claims can be offered to you.
We do not use your photographs to price your policy, to assess an existing claim, or to make any decision that increases your premium.

heading: 3. Who can see your photographs
paragraphs: Photographs are visible to the assessment team reviewing your property and to the underwriting contact at your insurer named on your policy. They are not published, sold, or shared with any other party.
Where an automated review is used to check that a photograph is usable, that check runs on the image alone and produces only a pass or retake result.

heading: 4. How long we keep it
paragraphs: Photographs and assessment findings are retained for the life of your policy plus seven years, after which they are deleted. You may request earlier deletion at any time, except where a claim is open against the assessment.

heading: 5. Your choices
paragraphs: You may decline this assessment entirely; declining does not affect your existing cover. You may skip any individual photograph, though an assessment cannot be closed until the full set is captured.

You may request a copy of everything held about your assessment, ask for a correction, or withdraw your consent for future assessments by contacting the support address at the foot of your photo list.

heading: 6. Security
paragraphs: Photographs are transmitted over an encrypted connection and stored encrypted at rest. Access is limited to the named individuals described in section 3 and every access is logged.
The link you were sent is unique to your assessment. Treat it as you would a password and do not forward it.

heading: 7. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: If this policy changes in a way that affects how your photographs are used, we will contact you at the email address held on your policy before the change takes effect.
